turns.replyText:
Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Here is how our two most popular setups compare to help you choose what works best for your kitchen:
• 222x2x11 Spice Rack Drawer: Features three compact drawers built to maximize vertical cabinet space. It holds up to 30 standard-sized spice jars (or up to 60 stacked half-size jars), making it the top choice for standard spice bottle collections.
• 33x1x11 Spice Rack Drawer: Features two wider 3.25" drawers designed specifically for larger spice containers, wider bottles, or oversized tins.
If most of your spices are standard store-bought jars, the 222x2x11 gives you the highest storage density. If you tend to buy larger bulk containers or wider bottles, the 33x1x11 is the better fit.
